meaning_en: To hit something very hard.
example_en: He accidentally bashed his knee on the table.
examples_extra: He bashed his knee against the sharp corner of the table.
The storm bashed the small boat against the rocks.
note_fa: محکم زدن — با -ash حس خشونت: smash, crash, bash.

meaning_en: Make a low, continuous humming sound.
example_en: The bees buzzed around the flowers.
examples_extra: We could hear the bees buzzing in the quiet garden.
My phone buzzed loudly during the important meeting.
note_fa: صدایِ وزوز؛ هم اسم هم فعل.

meaning_en: To make a loud, metallic sound.
example_en: The metal gate clanged shut.
examples_extra: The heavy metal gate clanged shut behind him.
We heard a loud clang from the kitchen.
note_fa: صدای بلند فلز؛ قوی‌تر و خشن‌تر از ring.

meaning_en: To press a button on a computer mouse.
example_en: Click the icon to open the program.
examples_extra: Click on the icon to open the file.
I heard the front door click behind me.

meaning_en: The sound of a horse's hooves.
example_en: We heard the clip-clop of horses outside.
examples_extra: We heard the clip-clop of horses on the road.
Clip-clop, clip-clop went the little pony's hooves.
note_fa: صدای سم اسب؛ شکل فعلی: clip-clopping.

meaning_en: To hit something hard, often causing damage.
example_en: The car crashed into a tree.
examples_extra: The two cars crashed at the corner.
He crashed his bike into a tree.

meaning_en: To run or move somewhere very quickly.
example_en: She dashed to catch the bus.
examples_extra: She dashed to the station to catch the train.
He made a dash for the door.

meaning_en: a long, deep cut in skin or a surface.
example_en: He had a gash on his arm from the fall.
examples_extra: He got a deep gash on his leg.
There was a gash in the wooden table.
note_fa: بریدگی عمیق و بلند؛ از cut جدی‌تر است.

meaning_en: a deep sound showing pain or unhappiness.
example_en: He let out a groan of pain.
examples_extra: The old man groaned with pain when he stood up.
She gave a loud groan when she saw the long queue.
note_fa: آه از درد یا ناراحتی؛ moan مشابه است.

meaning_en: a low, angry sound made by an animal.
example_en: The dog gave a low growl.
examples_extra: The dog growled angrily at the stranger by the gate.
We heard a lion growl somewhere in the dark zoo.
note_fa: غرش حیوان؛ برای سگ (dog) رایج است.

meaning_en: to complain in a quiet, unhappy way.
example_en: He always grumbles about the weather.
examples_extra: He always grumbles about the price of petrol.
The old neighbours grumbled over the noise next door.

meaning_en: easily annoyed and often in a bad mood.
example_en: Don't be so grumpy today!
examples_extra: Don't be so grumpy! It's a beautiful sunny morning.
My grandfather gets grumpy when he is hungry.
note_fa: بدخلق؛ برای صبح‌ها رایج: grumpy in the morning.

meaning_en: Crush food until it is soft.
example_en: Can you mash the potatoes for dinner?
examples_extra: Mash the potatoes with a fork.
She mashed the bananas for the baby.

meaning_en: The sound a cat makes.
example_en: The hungry cat started to meow loudly.
examples_extra: The cat meowed at the door.
I can hear a cat meowing outside.

meaning_en: to complain in an unhappy voice
example_en: He always moans about the weather.
examples_extra: He's always moaning about the weather.
Stop moaning and do something!

meaning_en: the sound a cow makes
example_en: The cow started to moo loudly.
examples_extra: The cow moos in the field.
I can hear the cows mooing.

meaning_en: To make a loud, deep sound like a lion.
example_en: The lion roared loudly in its cage.
examples_extra: The lion's roar echoed through the zoo.
The crowd gave a roar of delight.
note_fa: غرش؛ roar with laughter: قهقهه زدن.

meaning_en: To break into many pieces violently.
example_en: He accidentally smashed the plate.
examples_extra: He smashed the window with a stone.
The vase smashed on the floor.

meaning_en: Force something out of your mouth.
example_en: He had to spit out the bad food.
examples_extra: He tasted the soup and spit it out.
The little baby spit out the medicine.

meaning_en: Make water fly up in drops.
example_en: The children loved to splash in puddles.
examples_extra: The kids splashed water at each other.
Huge waves splashed loudly against the rocks.

meaning_en: Send out liquid in tiny drops.
example_en: She sprayed water on the plants.
examples_extra: She sprayed some perfume on her wrist.
Farmers spray their crops to kill insects.

meaning_en: Scatter small drops or pieces over something.
example_en: Sprinkle some cheese on top of the pasta.
examples_extra: Sprinkle some sugar on your breakfast cereal.
She lightly sprinkled salt over the chips.

meaning_en: To flow out suddenly and quickly.
example_en: Water spurted from the broken pipe.
examples_extra: Blood spurted from the deep cut quickly.
He put on a spurt to win.

meaning_en: To post a message on the social media service Twitter.
example_en: She tweeted about her new project.
examples_extra: She tweeted about the concert.
He tweets something every single day.

meaning_en: to breathe with a whistling sound
example_en: He started to wheeze after running fast.
examples_extra: He wheezed after running upstairs.
The old man wheezed loudly.

meaning_en: to make a clear sound with your lips
example_en: He whistled a happy tune.
examples_extra: He whistled a happy tune.
The referee whistled loudly. twice.

meaning_en: to move very quickly, making a sound
example_en: The car whizzed past us.
examples_extra: The car whizzed past us.
A bullet whizzed right overhead.
